reviews.review_title: The First AI offline on Quest 3!
reviews.review_description:
This is the first and only offline AI app ever made for Meta Quest 3!

It’s really impressive to think that everything is running locally, without the need for servers, an internet connection, or anything else.

What makes it even more complete is the ability to talk directly to the AI using your voice and even receive an audio response in addition to the written one (although this feature is still a little slow at the moment).

The written responses, however, are definitely fast, especially considering that everything is running locally!

It’s available in several languages besides English, including Italian.

What impressed me the most is that you can also send it screenshots and, almost instantly, it describes what it’s seeing. I thought a feature as complex as image analysis and understanding was something limited to online AI systems!

developer_response.body: Thank you very much for the 5 star review! Your support means a lot to us, and we'll keep on improving the app with more AIs and features. Thank you once again 🙏
